panels.title: Refusals by service
panels.description: Refusals in the time range, one bar for each service. The variable Service filters the log table only. Reads cellgw_refusals_total, envd_spec_refusals_total, envd_revocations_refused_total, cellctl_refusals_total, store_proxy_denials_total, cell_proxy_tunnel_refused_requests_total, cellproxy_gateway_exports_denied_total, cluster_jwt_attestations_total, relay_connections_total.

targets.expr: (sum(((cellgw_refusals_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} unless cellgw_refusals_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} offset $__range) or increase(cellgw_refusals_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

(sum(((envd_spec_refusals_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} unless envd_spec_refusals_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} offset $__range) or increase(envd_spec_refusals_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

(sum(((envd_revocations_refused_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} unless envd_revocations_refused_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} offset $__range) or increase(envd_revocations_refused_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

(sum(((cellctl_refusals_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} unless cellctl_refusals_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} offset $__range) or increase(cellctl_refusals_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", service_name!="m15-synthetic"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

(sum(((store_proxy_denials_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} unless store_proxy_denials_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} offset $__range) or increase(store_proxy_denials_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", service_name!="m15-synthetic"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

(sum(((cell_proxy_tunnel_refused_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} unless cell_proxy_tunnel_refused_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} offset $__range) or increase(cell_proxy_tunnel_refused_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", service_name!="m15-synthetic"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

(sum(((cellproxy_gateway_exports_denied_total{k8s_cluster_name="management", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} unless cellproxy_gateway_exports_denied_total{k8s_cluster_name="management", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} offset $__range) or increase(cellproxy_gateway_exports_denied_total{k8s_cluster_name="management", service_name!="m15-synthetic"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

(sum(((cluster_jwt_attestations_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", result="refused", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} unless cluster_jwt_attestations_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", result="refused", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} offset $__range) or increase(cluster_jwt_attestations_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", result="refused", service_name!="m15-synthetic"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

(sum(((relay_connections_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", result=~"overloaded|source_limit|upstream_write_failed", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} unless relay_connections_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", result=~"overloaded|source_limit|upstream_write_failed", service_name!="m15-synthetic"} offset $__range) or increase(relay_connections_total{k8s_cluster_name="dev-cp", result=~"overloaded|source_limit|upstream_write_failed", service_name!="m15-synthetic"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)
